trigger.description: Create a service to capture data changes from a MySQL database using CDC

metadata.label: Table
metadata.description: The fully-qualified table name to capture events from. Format: `<database>.<table>`

validations.message: Table must be in the format: <database>.<table>. Use square brackets for names with dots (e.g., db.[schema.name].table)

section.label: Configure MySQL CDC Listener
section.description: Select an existing MySQL CDC listener or create a new one

createNew.label: Create new
createNew.description: Create a new MySQL CDC listener

useExisting.label: Use existing
useExisting.description: Select an existing MySQL CDC listener

existingListener.label: Listener(s)
existingListener.description: Select one or more existing listeners to attach to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Host
metadata.description: The hostname of the MySQL Server

metadata.label: Port
metadata.description: The port number of the MySQL Server

metadata.label: Username
metadata.description: The username for the MySQL Server connection

metadata.label: Password
metadata.description: The password for the MySQL Server connection

metadata.label: Databases
metadata.description: List of databases to capture changes from. If not specified, events from all databases will be captured.

metadata.label: Insert events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture INSERT events

metadata.label: Update events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture UPDATE events

metadata.label: Delete events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture DELETE events

metadata.description: Storage configuration for the internal schema history

metadata.label: Offset Storage
metadata.description: Storage configuration for CDC offsets

metadata.label: CDC Service
metadata.description: Handles MySQL change-data-capture events (row reads, inserts, updates, deletes) delivered by the attached MySQL CDC listener.
